notes: Pokémon editor — IV/EV editing. In a Gen 3 game's Edit save dialog, tap any party Pokémon to open its editor: toggle Shiny, set IVs (0–31, with a Max button), and set EVs (0–255 each, capped at 510 total). Stats are recomputed from the game's real base stats (via the Pokédex) so they update in-game too, and the save is backed up first. Verified on a real Emerald save. Next: move editing, then one-tap event Pokémon.
